clauses.quote: You agree that all payments are non-cancelable for the Initial Subscription Term or the then-current Renewal Term, as applicable, and are final and non-refundable, unless otherwise agreed to by Zoom, required by Law, or set forth in your Order Form.
clauses.rationale: Payments are strictly non-cancelable and non-refundable for the entire term.

clauses.quote: Zoom may make modifications, deletions, and additions to this Agreement (“Changes”) from time to time in accordance with this Section 15.1.
clauses.rationale: Unilateral right to alter or add to the contract terms.

clauses.quote: You agree to resolve certain disputes with Zoom through binding arbitration (“Arbitration Agreement”). Arbitration means that an arbitrator, and not a judge or a jury, will decide the dispute.
clauses.rationale: Requires binding arbitration before an arbitrator instead of judge or jury trial.

clauses.quote: The parties expressly waive the right to bring or participate in any kind of class, collective, or mass action, private attorney general action, or any other representative action.
clauses.rationale: Explicit waiver of class, collective, mass, and representative action rights.

clauses.quote: ZOOM AND ITS AFFILIATES AND EACH OF THEIR LICENSORS, AND SUPPLIERS WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY: SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES;
clauses.rationale: Total exclusion of special, indirect, consequential, and punitive damages.
